steers.title: 7 recent losses look like wrong-side trades
steers.detail: Multiple losses >2% of position suggest we're fading momentum. Check if signals are aligned with trend.

deep_analysis:
MARKET: BTC is SHORT_BIAS on both 15m and 4h, sitting AT its EMA300 (continuum AT), Wyckoff DISTRIBUTION, trend_quality STRONG_DOWN. The 5m scan shows 23 SHORT_BIAS vs 15 LONG_BIAS tokens — the tape is down. The winning side right now is SHORT, and the signals engine agrees: pump-chain- is firing constant SHORT signals across the board (ALGO, KNEIRO, KBONK, CFX, GMT, BLUR, HBAR all at oversold RSI 12-45).

OPEN TRADES — BOTH ON THE WRONG SIDE:
1. ME LONG (16287, -0.35%): ME is SHORT_BIAS (conf 56.4, slope -0.034, -0.55% over 16 candles) and the engine is simultaneously firing a ME SHORT (volume-buildup-, RSI 10.34). We are long a coin that is actively dumping with a live short signal against us. bb-bounce-v2-long+ in a SHORT_BIAS tape is a counter-trend catch of a falling knife. Would NOT open fresh. SL at 1.5% is ~13x current hourly ATR (0.11%) — so wide it will not help until the dump is already deep; R:R is only 1:1 anyway. EXIT ON ANY BOUNCE.
2. DOGE LONG (16284, -0.13%): picked by the last ai-trader cycle. DOGE is NEUTRAL conf 51.2 — flat tape, no edge. meta_rsi 46.15 is mid-band. SL is 0.30% below entry and price is currently 0.075% above that SL — one sneeze from a -0.30% stop-out (x5 lev = -1.5% on margin). The 1.59% TP is fine if the bounce materializes, but we are drifting with zero momentum. If DOGE prints below 0.0796, that is the market telling us the side is wrong — do not re-long.

PORTFOLIO: 2/6 slots, 100% LONG against a SHORT_BIAS tape. Zero shorts while the engine floods short signals. This is the exact recurring failure the brain has on record: 'system is not taking any shorts, and losing on the longs.'

TODAY: 16 closed, -4.21% net. Recent 20: 9W/11L, net -0.27. The last ai-trader pick (ARB LONG, RSI 51.35, NEUTRAL conf 42 regime) lost -4.64% — it was a LONG against a gently falling coin, picked while the note in the pick itself warned 'do not repeat that mistake of ignoring coin-level regime.' The pick before that (DOGE) is the currently open loser-in-waiting. ai-trader+ lifetime: 28T, 42.9% WR, -$0.75. The signal is bleeding because it keeps picking LONGS in a short tape.
regime_context: BTC: SHORT_BIAS 15m + SHORT_BIAS 4h, continuum AT EMA300 (216 bars above the last cross), Wyckoff DISTRIBUTION, linreg_alignment 0.25 (weak), trend_quality STRONG_DOWN. Acceleration is POSITIVE and linreg_direction LEAN_BULL on the 1m — a short-term bounce attempt inside a down structure — but the 15m/4h structure is what pays. 5m aggregate: SHORT_BIAS (23 short / 15 long / 84 neutral). Market phase RECOVERY on a DISTRIBUTION tape = dead-cat bounces that trap longs. This is NOT a long-hunting regime. Every pump is a short opportunity until BTC reclaims and holds EMA300 with rising 15m slope. Top downtrends by confidence: GMX 94.3, NEO 90.5, ACE 88.1, SEI 84.6, SAND 84.0 — all printing lower highs for 16+ candles.
pattern_alerts:
PATTERN 1 — WRONG-SIDE LONGS (VERIFIED, last 20 closed):
16 LONGs went 8W/8L for net -$0.20; the 4 SHORTs went 1W/3L for -$0.07. The big losers were all LONGs against down tapes: ARB -4.64% (LONG in NEUTRAL-42 conf, chg16 -0.63%), ETC -4.13%, BANANA -2.24%, LDO -2.22%, IO -2.11%. The winners were LONGs that caught real bounces (ME +2.10% at RSI 40.7, ETC +2.12% at RSI 50) and the one clean SHORT (HBAR +3.29%). WINNING SIDE: short the dumps (HBAR SHORT +3.29% was the best trade of the 20). We were on the wrong side of ARB, ETC, BANANA, LDO, IO because we longed coins with falling 16-candle slopes. Why weren't we shorting them? Because the ai-trader keeps defaulting to LONG.

PATTERN 2 — ai-trader+ LONG PICKS LOSE (VERIFIED from signal_performance):
ai-trader+ = 28T, 12W (42.9% WR), -$0.75 total. Combined with ai-trader- (2T, -$0.12), ai-trader-pending (2T, -$0.10), ai-trader-manual (13T, +$0.47): the automated picks are net negative while manual picks are net positive. The fix is not signal params — it is regime alignment: the last three automated picks (SAND LONG unfilled, DOGE LONG open, ARB LONG -4.64%) all ignored coin-level SHORT_BIAS/NEUTRAL regime.

PATTERN 3 — DEAD LONG SIGNALS (VERIFIED, signal_performance):
volume-breakout-long+: 17T, 3W (17.6% WR), -$1.03 — worst signal in the book. doji-bottom-long: 21T, 42.9%, -$0.50. bb-bounce-v2-long+: 28T, 46.4%, -$0.46. hmacd_mtf-+: 8T, 25%, -$0.46. These are all counter-trend long-family signals bleeding in a down tape. Do not disable them (brain auditor's job), but understand: every one of these fired while BTC was SHORT_BIAS. The winning counterparts: pump-chain+ is +$1.51 (49T), volume-buildup- is 77.8% WR, r2v2-long3 is 66.7% WR. Trend-aligned beats counter-trend, exactly as the philosophy states.

PATTERN 4 — SHORT RSI DEATH ZONE CAVEAT:
The 45-55 SHORT band is 15-22% WR over 7d (precheck death-zone advisory) — but that band is dominated by CHOP shorts against mixed tapes. The exception is clean high-confidence downtrends (r2 > 0.7, conf > 80), which is what a SAND SHORT setup looks like. Short the confirmed trends, not the RSI mid-band chop.
